review_type: independent source acceptance review; zero implementation authorship

A_scope_and_live_readiness.covered_in_source: T05/T06 identity seven fields and card; T17/T18 company/title; T21/T22 eight section expanders, member and admin, warm and after actual extension reload. UI edits use CDP pointer and key events; field saves use a member row created by this run and a private durable prewrite field intent. Existing admin/member saved-field cases are explicitly unverified; expander cases can run without a persisted write.
A_scope_and_live_readiness.material_gap: The warm field cases save and restore their original fields before reloadExtension. The post-reload cases edit and save new values only after reload. Thus both can pass when extension reload loses a previously saved Identity or Employment value, despite the inventory's persistence-after-reload criterion. Preserve an owned saved value across the actual reload, assert all fields and identity card immediately after re-opening, then restore through the journal before conditional deletion.
A_scope_and_live_readiness.native_status: No native browser execution in this review. Chrome date input, UI selectors, role/build identity, and actual conditional restoration remain unverified on the loaded extension. The report's source_ready_partial_scope_native_unverified status is accurate.

findings.finding: Field values are restored before the extension reload. The subsequent field pass only proves a save/reopen inside the newly loaded panel; it cannot reject lost persisted fields during reload.
findings.negative_guard: Plant a reload behavior that resets one saved identity or employment field, while ordinary save/reopen still works. The current sequence can remain green because it reloads only the restored baseline; a fixed oracle must turn red.

findings.finding: PROFILE_EXTENDED_CASES defaults off, and final status only searches existing cases for 'unverified'. A valid base run with the flag absent can report passed with none of T05/T06/T17/T18/T21/T22 recorded. The extended acceptance request needs an exact case-and-dimension census before an overall pass.
findings.negative_guard: Run a source-bound or native receipt with the extended flag omitted and assert the extended acceptance gate fails for missing expected case IDs/dimensions; verify admin saved-field unverified yields partial.

positives: The requested field labels, DB columns and eight section names match the current Profile UI and case procedures.

The field journal persists intent before Save and validates owner, organization, marker, creation time, version and intended fields before advancing; cleanup deletes the exact owned row and verifies absence.
Field-case restoration attempts run after an earlier UI failure, and unresolved journal state prevents conditional deletion.
Existing-row saved-field cases are explicitly unverified, with overall partial status when the extended flag is on.

checks.field_successor_mutation: Removed pending.fields comparison in an isolated temporary copy; node --test exited 1 with one failing test.
checks.source_oracle_review: The reload and missing-case gaps above are reachable green paths by the runner's control flow; no browser or DB was used.

limits: No native browser, database mutation, build, release, or implementation edit occurred.
The source report contains no private profile values, identity, credentials, or raw errors.
The separate admin saved-field omission is an allowed incomplete coverage result, not full acceptance.
